limitations: These 17 cases establish only the listed request shapes and fixture state; they do not verify every route or authorization branch.
The source-inspected route ledger contains candidates and remains unverified unless an executable case is added and passes.
Error paths, pagination beyond the fixture, scanner jobs, CRUD lifecycle operations, and concurrent load are outside this core-flow run.
